title: channels__collect — output
$comment: x-status: planned — quorum semantics unresolved; open questions: (1) Quorum semantics: does 'count' mean count-of-ACKs-with-status=done, count-of-any-reply messages, or configurable via status_filter? Current lean: configurable via status_filter, defaulting to any reply. (2) Cancel verb: no cancel verb defined in v1; timeout is the only termination path. (3) Multiple-collector semantics: can two agents call channels__collect with the same reply_to simultaneously? Likely yes — each collector holds an independent wait; needs conformance test.
description: Output schema for the SOX channels__collect operation. Returns the set of replies received before count was reached or timeout elapsed. Partial-failure semantics are explicit: received + missing + timed_out together give the full picture. PLANNED: quorum semantics, cancel verb, and multiple-collector behaviour are open questions (see $comment). Normative reference: docs/decisions/fanout-collect.md.

received.description: ACK records received before the collect completed (either count reached or timeout elapsed).

agent_id.description: The agent that sent the ACK.

message_id.description: The message_id of the reply (same as the reply_to input).

acked_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the ACK was recorded.

missing.description: agent_ids of group members who had not ACK'd by the time the collect completed. Derived from the group's membership table minus the received set. Empty if all expected members responded.

timed_out.description: True if the collect returned because the timeout elapsed before 'count' qualifying replies were received. False if count was reached before timeout.
